top_signals.title: One ECB Rate Hike 'Could Be Enough,' ING's Blom Says
top_signals.summary:
Marieke Blom, chief economist and global head of research at ING, discusses the outlook for tomorrow's European Central Bank decision on interest rates. "If you look at core inflation, services, wages, and so forth, we don't see that much inflationary pressure," Blom tells Bloomberg Television. "We believe that one rate hike could be enough."
(Corrects amount of interest-rate forecast in on-screen graphic at 02:18.) (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Treasuries Weaken as Rising Oil Prices Boost Rate-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: Treasuries fell as traders worried that rising oil prices will fan inflation and add to pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates as soon as next week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Stocks and Bonds Fall as Brent Pushes Past $100: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stocks and Treasuries slid in a market where inflation risks are the primary focus, with Brent crude topping $100 a barrel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: US Air Force seeks ‘rapidly deployable’ drone swarms for base security
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Air Force is looking to use "rapidly deployable" swarms of AI-controlled drones for base security.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Crypto lobbying orgs ask court to suspend Illinois tax as legal case continues
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: What could happen if the CLARITY Act fails to pass in 2026
top_signals.summary: The US Senate has a limited window to pass a crypto market structure bill, but if it were to fail, the legislation could be completely remade or scrapped under Democrats in 2027.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
